subject.title: Session bloat: skillsSnapshot and systemPromptReport accumulated on every run

question: Should OpenClaw remove full inline systemPromptReport from persisted session entries by splitting out compact warning-dedupe state and recomputing or referencing heavyweight diagnostics?
rationale: The source path is clear, but changing durable session metadata affects warning dedupe, /context diagnostics, upgrade behavior, and the ongoing database-first storage direction.

options.title: Split Compact State
options.body: Persist only the small state needed across restarts and rebuild or reference heavyweight prompt diagnostics on demand.

options.title: Keep Inline Report
options.body: Accept the sessions.json size cost until a broader database-first session migration or diagnostics redesign owns the storage shape.

options.title: Land Skills Mitigation Separately
options.body: Treat the linked PR as a partial skillsSnapshot fix and keep this issue open specifically for systemPromptReport payload policy.

recommendation.title: Split Compact State
recommendation.body: Persist only the small state needed across restarts and rebuild or reference heavyweight prompt diagnostics on demand.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the clearest recent ownership signal for the prompt-blob mitigation and adjacent session-store persistence tradeoffs.
